title: Decode mouse social competition outcomes
input_description: Aligned cortical calcium signals from both mice in a tube-test trial.
output_description: One predicted winner identity for each trial; the evaluator converts identities to fixed binary labels.
native_split_description: The author code supports trial-, mouse- and file-level splits. Released trial membership and the selected evaluation grouping remain unbound.
reason: A 17-example processed validation cache with winner labels is verified. Matching training signals, stable trial provenance and a defined independent evaluation split for the planned source task remain unavailable.
